translationRepairs: Zhou had shared exile principles with Tan Xian Borsheng of his commandery and Yin Mo Junzhang of Yanmen under Wang Mang.
Zhou, together with Tan Xian, styled Bosheng, of his commandery and Yin Mo, styled Junzhang, of Yanmen, all kept their integrity and refused office under Wang Mang.

谭贤伯升 and 殷谟君长 are personal name plus courtesy name, so the fused "Tan Xian Borsheng" / "Yin Mo Junzhang" forms are wrong; but 俱守节不仕王莽世 means they kept integrity and refused office in Wang Mang's age, not that they "shared exile principles."
He changed his name to Yunqi Yao, styled Houguang, and hid with his wife between Qi and Lu.
He therefore changed his surname to Yunqi, his personal name to Yao, and his courtesy name to Houguang, and hid with his wife between Qi and Lu.
易姓运期，名耀，字侯光 separately changes surname, personal name, and courtesy name; the original "Yunqi Yao" collapses 姓 and 名, and the proposed wording restores that distinction.
Late in Jianwu the five princes lodged in the Northern Palace, each fond of retainers; none could lure Jing Dan.
Late in Jianwu the five princes, including Prince Liu Fu of Pei, lodged in the Northern Palace; all loved hosting guests and in turn sent to invite Jing Dan, but could not bring him.

沛王辅 must be named among 五王, and 更遣请丹，不能致 should be restored; but "Prince Liu Fu of Pei and the other five princes" wrongly implies six princes, whereas 沛王辅等五王 means the five including Prince Fu of Pei.
Fa Zhen, styled Gaoqing, was a native of Mei in Fufeng—the transmitted text garbles the county logograph—and son of Nan commandery prefect Fa Xiong.
Fa Zhen, styled Gaoqing, was a native of Mei in Fufeng and son of Nan commandery prefect Fa Xiong.
法真字高卿，扶风郿人 has no textual note about a garbled county graph; the parenthetical about a garbled logograph is invented English.
Twice the Minister of Works called; he dodged a year, then pretended to comply, marched his family toward Luoyang, and bolted into the Jiangxia hills.
Twice the Minister of Works called; he dodged a year, then pretended to comply, marched his family along the road, and bolted into the Jiangxia hills.
既行在道，因逃入江夏山中 places them already on the road with no destination city named; "toward Luoyang" invents a place absent from the Chinese.
Zhang said, "When Zhao slew the bleating kid, Confucius turned back from the river;
Zhang said, "When Zhao slew Mingdu, Confucius turned back from the river;
赵杀鸣犊 refers to the person Mingdu; rendering 鸣犊 as "the bleating kid" invents an animal victim and erases the named official in the Confucius anecdote.
Now your lord's lord toils others while indulging himself, roams and plays without restraint.
Now your lord toils others while indulging himself, roams and plays without restraint.
今子之君 is simply "your lord"; "your lord's lord" doubles 君 without Chinese support.
He was Ma Rong's and Su Zhang's contemporary; though Ma won fame for breadth and Su for honesty, both bowed to Jiao as their better.
He was Ma Rong's and Su Zhang's contemporary; though Ma won fame for breadth and Su for honesty, both deferred to Shen as their senior.
皆推先于慎 means Ma and Su deferred to Shen as senior/foremost; "bowed to Jiao as their better" invents moral superiority and misreads 推先.
Under Guangwu both men were summoned; neither appeared.
During the Jianwu era, all three men were summoned, but none appeared.
并 refers to all three men named in the preceding sentence, and 建武中 is the Jianwu era rather than a direct title reference to Guangwu.
In the Jianwu era they were summoned, yet neither came.
During the Jianwu era, all three were summoned, but none came.
The literal also must use a plural form appropriate to the three named men.
Minister Hou Ba offered him the higher seat.
Hou Ba, the Minister of Education, offered to yield his office to Wang Ba.
让位于霸 identifies Hou Ba's own office as the position offered and Wang Ba as the recipient; expanding both names prevents confusion.
Minister of Education Hou Ba yielded his place to Ba.
Hou Ba, the Minister of Education, offered to yield his office to Wang Ba.
The same two-name clarification is required in the literal field because both men share the given name Ba.
遂止 leaves the agent unstated after Yan Yang's criticism, so the draft's claim that Hou personally dropped the idea is too specific.
Further summons failed; he died at home in old age.
He was repeatedly summoned but never appeared, and eventually died at an advanced age.
连征 and 以寿终 support repeated unanswered summons and death at an advanced age, but not the invented claim that Wang Ba died at home.
